final: SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference, AVG(sp.remaingb) / (SELECT AVG(group_avg_storage) FROM (SELECT AVG(sp2.remaingb) AS group_avg_storage FROM scanprocessing AS sp2 JOIN sites AS s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = sp2.zoneref GROUP BY sp2.zoneref, s2.insurstat)) AS ratio_to_mean_group_avg_storage FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY ratio_to_mean_group_avg_storage DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
